publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Read-only skill. It asks the owner's HomeGuardian gateway for status and alerts; without that gateway it says the service is unreachable and asserts nothing. It cannot change settings, start capture, or show camera media.

en-US.name: HomeGuardian AI(dhar)
en-US.summary: Read-only voice status for a HomeGuardian installation.
en-US.description: Asks the existing HomeGuardian service for home status, alerts, camera availability, detected activity, routines and an emergency advisory summary. Read-only: it cannot change settings or start capture.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Home Guardian for the home status
Alexa, ask Home Guardian for the alert summary
